target.description: Research, compare and evaluate the next-generation Project Cockpit through browser-rendered experiments, preserve full decision history and exact implementation provenance, perform source-faithful holistic reintegration under deterministic gates, and evaluate unresolved whole-product interaction/presentation on the complete integrated Cockpit.

known_exposures: Specification 008 and Foundation 021 establish the promoted Cockpit architecture and professional product direction.
Accepted Phase-C mechanisms are bound to exact implementation provenance through the 23-entry manifest and remain protected by deterministic browser gates.
Quiet Graphite, Boxes/Text, A6 and Conversation coexistence remain the held Conversation direction.
The first holistic integration was rejected; Research 088 identified manual reimplementation from summaries as the fidelity failure mode.
Checkpoint 251 established source-faithful holistic reintegration as the protected whole-product substrate.
Checkpoint 255 flattened the current right rail and replaced the static Deep Dive compass with a live Project-Grid-derived topology instrument.
Research 096 and Checkpoint 256 established the accepted Conversation visible-separation target and the current flat rail control set.
Checkpoint 257 made the plain cockpit-reintegration.html route canonical while preserving explicit historical study routes.
Research 097 introduced the opt-in Adaptive Conversation Dock candidate; its product-design review remains open rather than promoted.
Research 098 repaired current-process Focus lifecycle asymmetry through DOM-independent membership state, WorkUnit-remount repair and synchronized node/relation recession.
The project owner currently reports Focus working as far as tested, so Focus is not under active repair.
Research 099 and Checkpoint 260 attempted to make Conversation spacing row-owned through 16px grid-item margins and 6px top/bottom row padding, with every non-Text state treated as Boxes/artifact.

Workflow run 33241369935 passed 74/74 browser tests at implementation target 29419f7a1ccbd3cbcdc98f333e1b594c01d63fb1, but subsequent human review still showed the WorkUnit artifacts visually touching.
Checkpoint 261 reconciled the unplanned ChatGPT conversation boundary and established chatgpt-10 / 10 - Project Cockpit Design Exploration without rewriting pre-boundary chatgpt-09 history.

The project owner's Checkpoint 260 live-browser diagnostic proved the current spacing stylesheet was loaded and the intended 16px margin plus 6px top/bottom padding were present, ruling out stale Git/browser assets as the cause.

A second live Chrome geometry diagnostic measured 54px WorkUnit grid-item rows with 16px computed bottom margins, while transformed node surfaces painted about 20.8px beyond each row, leaving only about 1.9px of actual visible surface separation.

Research 100 identifies CSS Grid auto-track sizing as the exact failure mechanism: item margins were accounted for by shrinking the stretched grid item while the transformed overflow-visible canonical WorkUnit continued painting beyond that row.

Checkpoint 262 replaces the failed margin-owned model with explicit 16px grid-track row-gap, zero row margins, 6px WorkUnit padding, 78px wide minimum WorkUnit row height and 73px minimum height at <=1450px. The canonical WorkUnit itself is unchanged.

Regression coverage explicitly exercises 1600px desktop, 1100px responsive and 760px narrow layouts, including legacy artifact state, and requires actual WorkUnit surface-to-surface gaps of at least 20px.
Workflow run 33247046868 passed 76/76 browser tests at implementation/test target b8a2d095214c3417f95180ca519c7b6224739181.
The project owner's Checkpoint 262 human retest confirms the WorkUnit spacing is now visually correct.

The same successful spacing screenshot exposed one residual defect: General project discussion was not fully contained as its own first rail object and the first WorkUnit visibly invaded that row at a wide but vertically short browser viewport.

Research 101 preserves the human-confirmed WorkUnit grid-track spacing and adds explicit project-row containment: 74px minimum project row height, 7px row padding, 58px project artifact minimum height and the existing 16px inter-track gap.
A new 1776x766 regression requires the General project discussion artifact to remain distinct from the first WorkUnit while preserving the >=20px WorkUnit surface gaps.
Workflow run 33247621778 passed 77/77 browser tests at implementation/test target 5913467cfffd535215da7ab2cb70bdeb2be9f2e9.
